scripts.dev: concurrently -n sidecar,api,mobile -c magenta,blue,green "uv run --project packages/api/sidecar python packages/api/sidecar/transcribe_sidecar.py" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/api -- --port 3030" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/mobile"
scripts.ios: cd apps/mobile && npx expo run:ios --no-bundler --device 'iPhone 17 Pro'
scripts.dev:api: concurrently -n sidecar,api -c magenta,blue "uv run --project packages/api/sidecar python packages/api/sidecar/transcribe_sidecar.py" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/api -- --port 3030"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=packages/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/mobile
